VI.description: Returns the child window of hwnd that contains a point through user32.dll ChildWindowFromPointEx (stdcall\2C called in any thread). The point is in hwnd's CLIENT coordinates and travels BY VALUE as a POINT {LONG x\2C LONG y}\2C passed here as one U64 pt with x in the low and y in the high 32 bits - the POINT's memory image\2C which is how an 8-byte struct is passed by value on x64 (one register) and on x86 (two stack slots). Only immediate children are searched\3B call it again with the answer for deeper ones. flags 5 (default) = CWP_SKIPINVISIBLE 1 + CWP_SKIPTRANSPARENT 4\3B 2 CWP_SKIPDISABLED. child is hwnd itself when no child contains the point and 0 when the point is outside hwnd. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: The point in hwnd's client coordinates\3A x in the low 32 bits\2C y in the high 32 bits (each a two's-complement LONG).
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: The child containing the point\2C hwnd itself when none does\2C 0 when the point is outside hwnd.
